original_test_intent: Visually check the chassis System Fault LED after power-on and after clearing BMC logs, while retaining undefined green states and the AMI-dependent Amber Blink coverage.
original_method: An on-site operator identifies the chassis fault indicator, captures baseline health and logs, powers on through the approved procedure, records Amber Solid, and performs the exact owner-approved log clear only after evidence preservation before recording the post-clear LED.
manual_activity: A qualified operator photographs the identified System Fault LED and captures health/SEL evidence before and after the approved power-on and optional log-clear sequence; undefined states remain unresolved.
required_inputs: Platform/revision-specific System Fault LED location, controller and complete state legend
Meaning of Amber Solid for active versus latched/historical faults
Expected power-on state and observation windows
AMI-provided Amber Blink code, trigger, cadence and acceptance
Definition or explicit N/A disposition for Green Solid and Green Blink
Exact BMC log/SEL source, archive method, approved clear command and authorization
Safe deterministic fault-free or approved fault precondition
Independent BMC/platform recovery and evidence retention policy
safety_requirements: Do not clear any BMC log or SEL until it is exported, hashed and approved for destruction
Do not use log clearing to conceal or manufacture an active fault indication
Do not invent an ipmitool command, target, credentials or AMI diagnostic code
Confirm the visual target is the chassis System Fault LED, not a PSU, UID, NIC or board indicator
Stop on unexpected power, BMC readiness, fault, thermal or recovery behavior
Never automatically retry power or log-clear actions
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and prepare the owner-approved state matrix
Collect read-only BMC inventory, health, SEL and event evidence before and after operator actions
Record the approved command text and exit status without exposing credentials
Correlate supplied photos/video to the audit timeline
Perform no log clear, power transition, fault injection, AMI code execution, visual verdict or retry
engineer_actions: Define the complete LED table and active-versus-latched Amber Solid behavior
Supply and approve the exact log clear plus preservation prerequisites
Provide AMI Amber Blink command/criteria and green-state disposition
Review visual, SEL and health evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly says the agent cannot observe the LED, but the source's unspecified destructive log clear also prevents safe remote execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep acceptance operator-controlled; use read-only health/SEL collection around a separately approved, audited clear step only if that step remains required.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: System Fault LED, power-on, pre/post BMC-log clear, Green/Amber states and 15/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL VISUAL CHECK WITH DESTRUCTIVE LOG-PRESERVATION GATE AND INCOMPLETE STATE TABLE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture chassis context, LED video, BMC health and immutable pre-clear SEL; distinguish active fault assertion from historical-event latch, then run the approved clear once and capture post-state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds indicator identity, evidence preservation, active-fault semantics, command authorization, observation timing and recovery without modifying Master Criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only telemetry can corroborate fault ownership but cannot replace visible color/cadence; undefined green and missing AMI Amber Blink remain uncovered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clearing a log changes diagnostic state but does not necessarily remove the condition driving an active fault LED. Conversely, some implementations latch an LED from an event record. Without distinguishing those models, an unchanged or cleared amber indication is not interpretable.

project_override_considerations: If the platform has no green states or no AMI locate/blink function, engineering may mark those states revision-scoped N/A; the decision must not be inferred from a single observation.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and unique-code result
LED physical/controller mapping and approved state/transition matrix
Pre-clear health and complete SEL/log export with hashes and authorization
Exact approved clear command, target, timestamp and exit status if executed
Timestamped before/after contextual and close LED photo/video plus post-clear health
Undefined-state disposition, no-unapproved-clear/no-fault-masking audit, recovery confirmation and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source explicitly marks both green states undefined and Amber Blink dependent on missing AMI code. Its incompleteness is preserved; no competing value or procedure is asserted for those states.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Amber Solid and the before/after observation are reviewable and can be executed manually after approval. Missing green and blink semantics remain pending coverage rather than preventing this static review.

review_improvement: Separates active and latched fault behavior, protects destructive SEL evidence, binds the exact chassis indicator and preserves all undefined states for owner action.
independent_technical_reasoning: A chassis fault LED can be driven by an active sensor assertion, a latched event, or an aggregate health policy. Clearing SEL may remove only historical records while the underlying assertion remains, so the expected post-clear amber state cannot be judged without simultaneous sensor and policy evidence. The irreversible loss of the pre-clear timeline makes archive-before-clear a validity requirement, not merely a logging preference.
